# Card reference {#sec-cards}

All cards in the game, with the level at which each one is introduced.
Use the search box (top left) to find a card by name.

| Card              | Type     | Level | Effect                                      |
|-------------------|----------|:-----:|---------------------------------------------|
| Quantum Leap      | Quantum  | 2     | Move a piece up to 3 squares                |
| Observer          | Quantum  | 2     | Measure any piece for free                  |
| Echo              | Timeline | 3     | Repeat your previous action                 |
| Decoherence       | Timeline | 3     | All superpositions on one row collapse      |
| Heisenberg        | Event    | 4     | Re-roll a measurement die                   |
| Branching Worlds  | Event    | 5     | Split a piece across the two boards         |
